summary: MCP URN resources endpoints and shared NL-to-URI router with negation and abstention

delivery.outcome: FixOS MCP exposes side-effect-free `urn:uuid:<uuid>` resources via `resources/list`, `resources/templates/list`, and `resources/read`, and unifies `ask`/shell/MCP natural-language routing on `wellmanifest.nl-plan/v1` with PL/EN diacritic normalization, negation blocking, and abstention (closing #165 and #167).
nonGoals: Extracting `cleanup_services` use cases is delivered separately in #169.
Governance manifest and Wellman standard-adoption updates are delivered in #168.

architecture.decision: Introduce `fixos/mcp_resources.py` for `urn:uuid:` resource listing/reading with retention and output-schema checks, and `fixos/nl_router.py` for deterministic `wellmanifest.nl-plan/v1` compilation wired into both `fixos/mcp_server.py` and `fixos/cli/ask_cmd.py`.
interfaceChanges: MCP JSON-RPC advertises `resources` and handles `resources/list`, `resources/templates/list`, and `resources/read`.

validation.evidence: URN resources list/pagination/templates/read and stdio safety pass.

commands: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_nl_router.py tests/unit/test_ask_and_nl_group.py tests/unit/test_mcp_server.py tests/unit/test_poa_grants.py -q
validation.evidence: Shared NL-to-URI router, negation, abstention, and RFC 8785 boundary vectors pass.
Governance, ruff, and scope checks pass.
